description: Site admins only (needs an 'admin'-scoped token). Whether CI failures are being turned into lessons: classified failures, lesson.pattern events (matched to a docs/ops/CI_GATE_LESSONS.md row, or candidates), recurring candidates, and failures left without a lesson for over an hour, over 7 days. 'N failures, 0 lessons' reads RED. Also each pattern's count and register row, and the register. Counts only: no log text or repository. Returns {health, patterns, register}.
name: gluecron_learning_status
